components.name: method
values: mosaic-seq | infect wild-type cell line with lentiviral dcas9-krab-blast vector then with barcoded sgrna-puro lentiviral library select with antibiotics perform drop-seq and associate single-cell transcriptomes with sgrna barcodes page 2 .

penetrance and contribution modeling | statistical model fitting to estimate single-cell penetrance percentage of cells with altered expression and expression contribution level of repression in those cells page 10 .
virtual facs | statistical framework using hypergeometric test to compare distribution of single-cell expression between perturbed and control cells page 5 .
